targets.authors: De Maio G, Bottini G, Ferrè ER
targets.title: Galvanic vestibular stimulation influences risk-taking behaviour.
targets.evidence_quote: The current study aimed to replicate and extend the findings of De Maio and colleagues (2021), in which a polarity-specific GVS effect was reported in the context of risk-taking.
targets.outcome_quote: Using a sample size informed by an a priori power analysis, a more rigorous experimental design (preregistered replication success criteria and analysis), similar sample demographics, and an additional risk-taking task, we did not succeed in replicating the polarity-specific vestibular effect found by De Maio et al 19 in our preregistered study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly state that the preregistered replication did not succeed.

reasoning: New participants re-tested the published polarity-specific effect. The added GDT was an extension, not a separate published target.
